mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_LoginHistory ( FACTORY_CODE, USER_ID, USER_NAME, LOGIN_DT, LOGIN_IP, LOGIN_TYPE, USER_AGENT, LOGIN_RESULT, FAIL_REASON ) VALUES ( #{factoryCode}, #{userId}, #{userName}, GETDATE(), #{loginIp}, #{loginType}, #{userAgent}, #{loginResult}, #{failReason} )
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_LoginHistory WHERE 1 = 1
AND FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode}
AND USER_ID LIKE '%' + #{searchUserId} + '%'
AND USER_NAME LIKE '%' + #{searchUserName} + '%'
AND LOGIN_RESULT = #{searchLoginResult}
AND LOGIN_DT >= CONVERT(DATETIME, #{searchStartDt})
AND LOGIN_DT <= CONVERT(DATETIME, #{searchEndDt} + ' 23:59:59')

SELECT LOGIN_HISTORY_ID, FACTORY_CODE, USER_ID, USER_NAME, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), LOGIN_DT, 120) AS LOGIN_DT, LOGIN_IP, LOGIN_TYPE, USER_AGENT, LOGIN_RESULT, FAIL_REASON, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), LOGOUT_DT, 120) AS LOGOUT_DT, SESSION_TIME, GOV_INTERFACE_YN, CONVERT(VARCHAR(23), GOV_INTERFACE_DT, 121) AS GOV_INTERFACE_DT, GOV_RECPTN_RSLT_CD, GOV_RECPTN_RSLT, GOV_RECPTN_RSLT_DTL, GOV_FAIL_REASON, GOV_REQUEST_JSON, GOV_RESPONSE_JSON FROM TB_LoginHistory WHERE LOGIN_HISTORY_ID = #{loginHistoryId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_LoginHistory SET LOGOUT_DT = GETDATE(), SESSION_TIME = DATEDIFF(MINUTE, LOGIN_DT, GETDATE()) WHERE LOGIN_HISTORY_ID = #{loginHistoryId}
mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 LOGIN_HISTORY_ID, FACTORY_CODE, USER_ID, USER_NAME, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), LOGIN_DT, 120) AS LOGIN_DT, LOGIN_IP, LOGIN_TYPE, USER_AGENT, LOGIN_RESULT, FAIL_REASON, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), LOGOUT_DT, 120) AS LOGOUT_DT, SESSION_TIME, GOV_INTERFACE_YN, CONVERT(VARCHAR(23), GOV_INTERFACE_DT, 121) AS GOV_INTERFACE_DT, GOV_RECPTN_RSLT_CD, GOV_RECPTN_RSLT, GOV_RECPTN_RSLT_DTL, GOV_FAIL_REASON, GOV_REQUEST_JSON, GOV_RESPONSE_JSON FROM TB_LoginHistory WHERE ISNULL(GOV_INTERFACE_YN, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY LOGIN_DT DESC, LOGIN_HISTORY_ID DESC

SELECT TOP 1 LOGIN_HISTORY_ID, FACTORY_CODE, USER_ID, USER_NAME, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), LOGIN_DT, 120) AS LOGIN_DT, LOGIN_IP, LOGIN_TYPE, USER_AGENT, LOGIN_RESULT, FAIL_REASON, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), LOGOUT_DT, 120) AS LOGOUT_DT, SESSION_TIME, GOV_INTERFACE_YN, CONVERT(VARCHAR(23), GOV_INTERFACE_DT, 121) AS GOV_INTERFACE_DT, GOV_RECPTN_RSLT_CD, GOV_RECPTN_RSLT, GOV_RECPTN_RSLT_DTL, GOV_FAIL_REASON, GOV_REQUEST_JSON, GOV_RESPONSE_JSON FROM TB_LoginHistory WHERE ( ( CONVERT(DATE, LOGIN_DT) >= CONVERT(DATE, #{fromDate}) AND CONVERT(DATE, LOGIN_DT) <= CONVERT(DATE, #{toDate}) AND GOV_INTERFACE_DT IS NULL ) ) ORDER BY LOGIN_DT DESC, LOGIN_HISTORY_ID DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_LoginHistory SET GOV_INTERFACE_YN = #{govInterfaceYn}, GOV_INTERFACE_DT = GETDATE(), GOV_RECPTN_RSLT_CD = #{govRecptnRsltCd}, GOV_RECPTN_RSLT = #{govRecptnRslt}, GOV_RECPTN_RSLT_DTL = #{govRecptnRsltDtl}, GOV_FAIL_REASON = #{govFailReason}, GOV_REQUEST_JSON = #{govRequestJson}, GOV_RESPONSE_JSON = #{govResponseJson} WHERE LOGIN_HISTORY_ID = #{loginHistoryId}
